newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE cocoa ends soft, volume still light.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE cocoa ends soft, volume still light.

text.p: LIFFE cocoa futures ended lower after a sluggish session on Tuesday.
July closed down four stg at 1,020 stg per tonne and September lost four to 1,037. Total volume was a lacklutre 1,749 contracts.
Most of the turnover came from light origin sales and some crossing. Traders said a firm crossed 250 July contracts at 1,021, which helped put July at the top of the most active list with 940 trades.
Otherwise, activity was dull. But traders tried to remain hopeful that a breakout would come soon. Traders said the rangebound trade and lack of volatility was usually a sign a big move was imminent.

Some traders speculated the next sharp move would be to the downside because New York's July contract held a hefty 31,557 lots of open interest as of Friday's close. They expected some outright liquidation to emerge before first notice day there.
A lower New York market would likely drag London down with it, they said.

New York said the CFTC's Commitment of Traders Report showed speculative long popsitions (non-commercial and nonreportable) showed an increase of about 4,000 lots in the two weeks ended May 20. New York traders said that dampened sentiment and sparked a flurry of speculative sales there at Tuesday's opening.
In options, no July contracts traded.
